clue.text: Thain's mirthful soundtrack?

parts.note: John Thain, the Merrill Lynch boss, was sacked in 2009; the recorded mirth dubbed onto sitcoms suits a man who has been fired

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what music a particular businessman would laugh along to.
explanation.walkthrough: John Thain was the Merrill Lynch chief executive ousted by Bank of America in early 2009, so he had been fired; his laughter would be the fired kind, the sort piped onto TV comedies.
explanation.definitionFit: Pre-recorded audience mirth added to a sitcom soundtrack is the stock term the pun on a sacked executive points to.

clue.text: Without compiler rejecting clue on troubled city

indicators.note: without signals that the compiler's letter is taken out of the pool before it is rearranged
troubled letters are stirred up and set in a new order

parts.note: the setter of a crossword refers to themself as I

explanation.surface: A setter refuses a clue about a city in difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without compiler' means the letters of REJECTING and CLUE ON, minus I (the compiler), are rearranged by 'troubled'. 'Rejecting' looks like the setter's action but is pure fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense, built-up urban area full of buildings is figuratively called this, likening a city to a wild forest.

clue.text: Seeing only cake?

definitions.meaning: seeing means observing or spotting something
cake with nothing on top has no sugar coating, so it is a plain sponge lacking its frosting

explanation.surface: Someone sees nothing but cake.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as NOT ICING, the second reading describes a bare cake.
explanation.definitionFit: Observing or spotting something is a direct synonym for the participle meaning seeing.

clue.text: Corrected heart valve using nothing for a change

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter, here the fifth of nine
using one thing in place of another marks a substitution in the word valve
for means instead of, so the letter a is swapped out for the nought

parts.note: nothing is zero, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A surgeon fixes a heart valve, perhaps by an unusual method.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corrected heart' looks like surgery but is the middle letter of 'Corrected'. In VALVE, O (nothing) replaces A, giving VOLVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To develop gradually into something different is a synonym for altering or transforming over time.

clue.text: See 1 across
Cuts neckbones

definitions.meaning: cuts as a verb: chops or slashes, as in budget reductions
the axis is the second vertebra of the neck, and this is its plural

explanation.surface: A butcher's sign: cuts of neckbone for sale.
explanation.definitionFit: Chopping tools double as a verb for cutting jobs, while the axis is the anatomical name of a neck vertebra.

clue.text: Large organisation preserves gentile carving

indicators.note: preserves means keeps safely inside, so one piece holds the other
organisation means arranging, so the letters of large are set out in a fresh order

parts.note: goy is a Yiddish word for a gentile, a non-Jew

explanation.surface: A big institution looks after a carving made by a non-Jewish artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Large organisation' reads as a big company, but 'organisation' is the signal to rearrange; 'gentile' uses the Yiddish term for a non-Jew.
explanation.definitionFit: A grotesque stone figure sculpted on a church roof, usually a waterspout, is a kind of architectural sculpture.

clue.text: It upset poet terribly to move with discretion

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the two letters of it are read bottom to top
terribly signals the letters of poet are mangled into another order

explanation.surface: Something distressed a poet so much that they had to tread carefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns IT into TI; 'terribly' rearranges POET into PTOE.
explanation.definitionFit: Walking on the balls of the feet is how one moves quietly and cautiously so as not to be heard.

clue.text: Endless prose about naturalist wiping out a corrupt group of constituencies

indicators.note: about means around, so the trimmed prose wraps the other piece
endless means with both ends lopped off, keeping the inner letters of prose
wiping out means erasing, so the article is removed from the naturalist's name

parts.note: Sir David Attenborough is the famous British natural-history broadcaster

explanation.surface: Dull writing about a nature presenter eliminating a dishonest set of electoral seats.
explanation.walkthrough: Rotten boroughs were tiny pre-1832 British parliamentary seats with almost no voters, whose MPs a patron effectively chose.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical British electorates with almost no voters, whose MPs were effectively appointed, were the byword for crooked representation.

clue.text: Tiny slice of tomato in fried onion: there's an idea

indicators.note: in places the slice within the jumbled onion
fried means cooked up, so the letters of onion are mixed
a tiny slice of tomato is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: A cook adds a sliver of tomato to fried onion and declares it a good idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A concept or belief held in the mind is a synonym for a thought or idea.

clue.text: Briefly order colliery to be run down

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, losing the final letter

parts.note: a decree is an official order or edict
a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: A quick instruction that a coal mine be wound down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run down' looks like the action ordered for the colliery but is the definition, read as an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilapidated or worn out by age and neglect is what decrepit and the adjective phrase both describe.

clue.text: Excuse for telegram, presumably?

definitions.meaning: an excuse is a false reason given to hide the real one
the telegram is a message form that came before mobile phone messaging

explanation.surface: Asking what excuse there might be for sending a telegram.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as PRE-TEXT, the second reading is what came before text messages.
explanation.definitionFit: A false reason put forward to conceal the real one is a synonym for a cover story.

clue.text: So, after the end of winter, green improvement

indicators.note: after places the intensifier behind the other pieces
the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: eco is the prefix for environmentally friendly, green things
so as an intensifier, as in so tired, means very

explanation.surface: Once winter ends, the greenery starts to come back.
explanation.definitionFit: A return to health or better condition is a synonym for getting better or improving.

clue.text: Blue instant bloomer

parts.note: mo is short for moment, an instant
a bloomer is a flower, and the rose is one

explanation.surface: A blue flower that blooms instantly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' is not a mistake or an item of underwear but literally a thing that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling blue means being sad or sullen, the sense of gloomy ill-humour.

clue.text: Large banks prohibit working in this country

indicators.note: the banks of a word are its edges, the outer letters

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit
working means switched on, operating

explanation.surface: Big banks are stopping people from working here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Large banks' reads as big financial institutions; it is the outside letters of 'Large'.
explanation.definitionFit: A Middle Eastern nation on the Mediterranean, its capital Beirut, is the country the clue's last words point to.

clue.text: Bite biter back

indicators.note: back means read backwards, from right to left

parts.note: a gnat is a small biting fly

explanation.surface: An instruction to bite back at whatever bit you.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp, pungent flavour with a kick to it is called bite, as in a sauce with real zing.

clue.text: Labour leader in hotel, upset after love tragedy

indicators.note: after places the hotel portion behind the zero

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: in puts the leading letter inside the jumbled hotel
upset means knocked over, so the letters of hotel are disordered
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Labour Party leader distressed in a hotel after a love tragedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare wrote this play about the jealous Moor of Venice, one of his great tragedies.

clue.text: Glove challenge

definitions.meaning: a heavy protective or armoured glove with a long cuff
throwing down the glove issued a challenge to fight

explanation.surface: A glove offered as a challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: A knight's armoured hand covering, thrown to the ground, was the traditional way to issue a dare to combat.

clue.text: Peril of dice curtailed on this kind of table

indicators.note: curtailed means docked of its tail, so each word loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Gambling with dice on a table is risky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' applies to each of the three words: PERI + O + DIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Mendeleev's chart of the chemical elements arranged by atomic number is called the periodic table.

clue.text: See 8
Dad's following message about you, said in error

indicators.note: following places the dad's piece behind the rest
about means around, so the fax surrounds the letter

parts.note: a fax is a message sent by facsimile machine

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the word you is replaced by the letter that sounds the same

parts.note: the word you is pronounced exactly like the letter U
pa is dad, and pa's gives the plural-looking ending

explanation.surface: Father, after a message about you, said something mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: A social blunder or embarrassing slip, French for false step, is a kind of mistake.

clue.text: See 27
See 1 down
Pluck of delicate zone ongoing

parts.note: twee means overly dainty or delicate

indicators.note: read as on going: the letters on depart from the word zone

explanation.surface: Plucking hair from a sensitive area continues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ongoing' is read as 'on going', removing ON from ZONE to leave ZE.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull out hairs with small pincers is to pluck them, as with eyebrows.

clue.text: Sport drink

definitions.meaning: a racket game played in a walled court
a fruit cordial diluted with water

explanation.surface: A sports drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The racket game played against walls shares its name with the British diluted fruit cordial drink.

clue.text: Relax with Macron's one victory finally reversed

parts.note: Emmanuel Macron is French president, and un is French for one
a win is a victory

indicators.note: finally means taking the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Macron loosens up as one of his victories is ultimately overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' looks like a reversal signal but only supplies its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To unwind is to relax after tension, like a coiled spring loosening.

clue.text: Parasite's work pattern very much includes leave

definitions.note: read as parasite is, a noun for the blood-sucking insect

parts.note: MO is modus operandi, a characteristic way of working

indicators.note: includes means holds within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: so as an intensifier means very much
to quit is to leave

explanation.surface: The parasite's habitual behaviour involves a lot of leave from work.
explanation.definitionFit: The bloodsucking insect that spreads malaria lives off its hosts, so it counts as a parasite.

clue.text: Role model he ain't, or otherwise

definitions.text: Role model he ain't, or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise means in another way, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Somebody who is no role model, or perhaps the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a protagonist who lacks heroic virtues is no role model.
explanation.definitionFit: A central character lacking conventional virtues is exactly someone nobody would look up to as an example.

clue.text: Problems from men cavorting with girls

indicators.note: cavorting means leaping about, so the letters jump into a new order

explanation.surface: Trouble arises when the lads frolic with the girls.
explanation.definitionFit: Imaginary imps blamed for faults in machines lend their name to unexplained snags and glitches.

clue.text: Almighty ally turns into a docile creature

indicators.note: turns means turns round, so the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: the Almighty is God
a pal is a friend or ally

explanation.surface: A powerful partner becomes meek.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pet dog kept on the lap, or by extension a servile follower, is a tame and docile animal.

clue.text: Playing slick soccer, the current results?

indicators.note: playing signals the letters are toyed with and rearranged

explanation.surface: Smooth football produces the results the team is getting now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current results' reads as the latest scores; here current is electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Jolts felt when electricity passes through the body are what an electric current produces.
